description: Jira API response caches for the Apache Hadoop architectural-refactoring study. Five directories: raw issues (.jira_cache), status changelogs (.jira_changelog), issue properties (.jira_props), assignee/reporter (.jira_assignee), and the ordinary-refactoring control group (.jira_control). These are point-in-time snapshots; Jira is live and a re-fetch will not reproduce them.

files_provenance.note: MANIFEST-v1.md advertised per-file SHA-256 digests that were absent from this JSON. Found 2026-08-11 during deposit assembly and repaired by deriving the digests from the archive at its already-recorded hash, so the provenance chain is unbroken. No cache file was modified and no number in the paper changes.
